_comment: Labels and milestones of the agent pipeline (docs/design/agent-pipeline.md, sections 4 and 7). Applied by host_tools/pipeline_setup.py. The order of the state labels is the order of the board columns.

labels.name: draft
labels.description: Written by the Planner, waiting for the owner's approval (gate 1b)

labels.name: ready
labels.description: Approved by the owner, waiting for the Builder

labels.name: building
labels.description: Builder is implementing; host tests run on each push

labels.name: rework
labels.description: Builder is fixing findings or a failed test

labels.name: needs-bench
labels.description: Waiting for the owner to plug the board for the on-target test

labels.name: awaiting-merge
labels.description: All evidence is there, waiting for the owner to merge (gate 2)

labels.name: waiting-for-me
labels.description: Blocked, disputed, rework cap reached or protected change: the owner referees

labels.name: cr
labels.description: Change request: one unit of work for the agent pipeline

labels.name: protected-change-approved
labels.description: Owner only: this pull request may touch a protected path

ruleset._comment: The existing ruleset on main (pull request, no force push, linear history). This tool only sets its required checks: tests, traceability and protected paths (design note section 5, build step 2).
ruleset.name: Protect_main_branch

milestones.title: Pipeline
milestones.description: Build steps of the agent pipeline (docs/design/agent-pipeline.md, section 9). A bucket for CRs, not a tagged release.

milestones.title: M6
milestones.description: Resilience + capstone (docs/roadmap.md). Scope is set by its ADR at gate 1a.
